The 2024 school year introduces a significant innovation in hand and nail care with  Cicalisse Hands and Nails by Embryolisse. This moisturizing and nourishing crème is specially designed for dry and very dry skin, offering a restorative and protective solution against daily external (and internal!) aggressions. This new crème is poised to become a must-have for anyone wanting to hydrate, protect, and deeply nourish their hands and nails.

Clinically proven effectiveness

The results from clinical tests are remarkable:

  • +107% skin flexibility,
  • +102% softness,
  • Strengthened nails and 100% hydrated cuticles.

These results were recorded after just 21 days of daily use among a sample of 34 individuals, all with sensitive skin, under dermatological supervision. This dual validation through clinical and self-evaluation ensures maximum effectiveness and guarantees user satisfaction.

Shea butter: a natural treasure

The key to this effectiveness lies in Shea Butter, a natural ingredient with extraordinary properties. Rich in active molecules known for their nourishing, restorative, and protective benefits for the skin, it penetrates quickly without leaving a greasy film, offering immediate and lasting comfort to the hands and damaged nails.

Embryolisse Cicalisse Cream
Moisturizer

Shea Butter is a precious ingredient recognized for its beneficial properties for the skin for centuries. It is obtained from shea nuts, primarily grown in West Africa. Its virtues include deep hydration, reduction of skin inflammation, and the repair of damaged tissues. By incorporating this ingredient into their new cream, Embryolisse guarantees maximum effectiveness and a lasting sense of well-being.

An ethical and sustainable sector

Embryolisse is dedicated to more responsible beauty practices by sourcing Shea Butter directly from communities in Ivory Coast, Burkina Faso, and Ghana. This ethical supply chain enables:

  • Over 350,000 women in Africa to benefit from stable employment and fair remuneration,
  • Improvement of living conditions for these women and their families through access to clean water and better living conditions.

This direct sourcing model not only ensures the high quality of the Shea Butter used but also supports local communities by providing economic opportunities and fair working conditions. Embryolisse is thus committed to a fair trade approach, promoting a fairer and more sustainable economy.

A natural and minimalist formula

Cicalisse Hands and Nails is composed of 97% ingredients of natural origin and contains only 10 carefully selected ingredients for their effectiveness and compatibility with the skin. This vegan formula is ideal for sensitive skin and addresses the needs of hands exposed to daily aggressions such as wind, cold, pollution, chemical products, and frequent hand washing.

The natural ingredients are chosen for their purity and effectiveness. Shea Butter plays a vital role, but other components like vegetable oils and plant extracts also enhance the cream’s overall effectiveness. This combination ensures intense hydration, rapid repair, and lasting protection for the skin and nails.

A practical and ecological format

The 30 ml nomadic format is perfect for everyday use and can be carried anywhere. The tube is made of 46% recycled plastic, representing a step towards more environmentally friendly packaging. This convenient format allows for quick and easy application at any time of the day, whether you are at work, on the go, or at home.

By choosing partially recycled packaging, Embryolisse demonstrates its commitment to reducing plastic waste and encouraging more eco-friendly practices. The cream’s compact size makes it easy to carry in a handbag, toiletry bag, or even a pocket, ensuring that your hands and nails remain protected and nourished throughout the day.

Cicalisse Hands and Nails, recommended by experts

Since 1950, Embryolisse has been recognized for its high-performance multi-functional care. The new Embryolisse cream benefits from the brand’s expertise and is recommended by pharmacists and endorsed by professional  makeup artists. This reflects the trust and acknowledgment of its effectiveness in the professional beauty and  skincare arena.

Professional makeup artists particularly appreciate the cream’s quick absorption and non-greasy finish, allowing for seamless use before applying makeup. Pharmacists recommend this cream for its proven effectiveness and formulation that respects sensitive skin. This dual validation reinforces the credibility and reputation of  Cicalisse Hands and Nails.

Usage and application tips

For optimal results, apply a small amount of cream to clean, dry hands, focusing on the driest areas and nails. Gently massage until fully absorbed. Use as often as needed throughout the day.

It is advisable to apply the cream after each hand wash to maintain consistent hydration and protect the skin from external aggressors. In winter, feel free to increase the application frequency to counteract the drying effects of the cold. For nails, pay particular attention to massaging the base of the nail and the cuticles to promote hydration and strengthening.

The Cicalisse Hands and Nails cream is the perfect solution for soft, nourished hands and strong nails. Its clinically proven effectiveness, ethical and sustainable commitment, and natural formula make it an essential product in any care routine. Available from September 2024, give your hands and nails the care they deserve with Embryolisse!
